name: ts-runtypes-monorepo
description: Compile-time runtime-type resolver on TypeScript 7 / typescript-go (tsgo).
author: ma-jerez

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm')) { console.error('\n\u274c  Use pnpm, not npm/yarn -- see CLAUDE.md #Setup.\n'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.check-format: oxfmt --check 'packages/**/*.ts' && prettier --check 'packages/**/*.md' && gofmt -l ts-go-runtypes/cmd ts-go-runtypes/internal && test -z "$(gofmt -l ts-go-runtypes/cmd ts-go-runtypes/internal)"
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:runtypes && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:test && tsc -p ts-go-runtypes/internal/testfixtures/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ts-go-runtypes/internal/testfixtures/atomic/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/examples/tsconfig.json
scripts.fresh-start: pnpm -r run fresh-start && node scripts/lib/rmrf.mjs node_modules && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
